sentence: Every line in the bag must hold at least one pair, so the number of pairs must never be less than the number of lines in the bag.
assumptions: qty is the number of pairs on each bag line.
A line at quantity 0 should have left the bag.

explanation.text: Shoppers press the quantity-down button on the bag page with no effect (E2, E3), and in these sessions a bag line reports a quantity of 0 (P4 min 0) yet stays in the bag with its own line total (P3). A line at quantity 0 should have left the bag; no existing rule checks quantities (R1 compares totals), so a rule that every line holds at least one pair would catch it without any price.
